about_the_game:
In the Ender Chariot Demo, players can experience the first character of the four - the Warrior!

Battle-hardened, he endured pain and fought bloodily, and growing up in the forest made him adept at using plants and clay to strengthen himself. Amidst endless slaughters, he sees the end of mortals. When he defeated the dragon and obtained the dragon's flesh and blood, he finally understood everything, and used his strong body to transcend the laws of reality and achieve a immortal self.

Players can face three hostile tribes and unlock the first three advanced challenges, but will not encounter the final enemy, the God of Eternal .

Don't take it lightly, though, these enemies are still very strong.
